title: 宇航员怎么生活
subtitle: 在太空里，什么都会飘
character: wearing a light blue t-shirt, navy trousers and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration drawn with soft wax crayons on dark navy paper, bright white, cyan and warm orange crayon strokes with visible waxy grain, simple friendly shapes

pages.zh:
我在书上看到一张照片：
宇航员在太空里飘着，
头发全都竖起来了。
他们在上面，
是怎么吃饭、怎么睡觉的呢？
pages.scene: The little boy lies on his stomach on the floor with an open book about space in front of him, propped on his elbows, looking fascinated.

pages.zh:
太空站绕着地球飞，
里面的人和东西，
都在一起往前掉，
所以谁也压不住谁。
这种感觉，叫做「失重」。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one space station shape on a dark navy background with three small round objects floating freely inside it, none of them touching the floor. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
在那里，
水不会往下流，
它会变成一个圆圆的球，
在空中慢慢地飘，
像一颗透明的大珠子。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one round transparent ball of water floating in the middle of a dark navy background, with small highlights on it and two tiny droplets beside it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
吃饭的时候，
饭菜装在袋子里，
汤要用吸管喝。
要是把饭倒出来，
它就会飘得到处都是。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one silver food pouch with a straw and one spoon floating side by side on a dark navy background, a few small round crumbs floating nearby. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
睡觉不用床。
宇航员钻进一个睡袋，
把睡袋绑在墙上，
然后就睡着了。
站着睡、躺着睡，都一样。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one sleeping bag fixed upright against a wall on a dark navy background, its straps clipped to the wall, empty and softly padded. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
洗澡也不一样。
水会到处飘，
所以他们用湿毛巾擦身体，
用免冲洗的洗发水洗头，
再用毛巾把水吸干净。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one folded damp towel and one small bottle floating side by side on a dark navy background. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
上厕所要用一个带吸力的马桶，
把东西吸走，
不然也会飘起来。
每一样东西，
都得固定好。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one small toilet unit with a hose attachment fixed to the wall on a dark navy background, with two handholds beside it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
在太空待久了，
骨头和肌肉会变弱，
因为不用使劲撑着身体。
所以宇航员每天都要运动，
跑步的时候还得绑上带子。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one treadmill fixed to a wall on a dark navy background with two elastic straps hanging from its frame, empty. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
要出舱的时候，
他们穿上白色的宇航服。
那件衣服很厚，
里面有空气、有水、有温度，
像一艘小小的飞船。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one white spacesuit with a round helmet shown from the front on a dark navy background, its backpack and tubes visible. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
在外面工作，
一定要挂上一根绳子，
把自己拴在太空站上。
不然轻轻一推，
人就飘走了，回不来。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one astronaut in a white suit floating outside a space station on a dark navy background, one bright tether line connecting the suit to the station. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
从窗户往外看，
地球又蓝又亮，
上面有白色的云，
有海，有陆地。
宇航员说，看一辈子也看不够。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one round window in a wall on a dark navy background, and through it a blue-and-white earth curving across the view. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我把被子卷起来当睡袋，
绑在椅子上试了试。
可惜我还是会往下掉。
等我长大了，
真想上去看看。
pages.scene: The little boy stands beside a chair with a rolled-up blanket tied to it, arms out as if floating, laughing at his own game.
